title: What is the most founder thing you have done?
intro: No judgement. Everyone reading this has done at least three of them.
og_line: Five questions and the thing you would rather not admit to.

cta.title: Something a bit more serious
cta.label: The Energy Discovery
cta.blurb: That one was for fun. The Energy Discovery is 48 statements and returns how you actually work across all twelve energies.

results.name: Worked through a holiday
results.headline: You took the laptop. Of course you did.
results.body: The trip happened around the work rather than instead of it, and you told yourself it was only an hour a day.
results.cost: The people who came with you noticed, and did not say.

results.name: Bought a domain at 2am
results.headline: It is still renewing.
results.body: The idea was excellent at 2am and it is possible it still is. You own the address either way.
results.cost: There are eleven of these and one of them was actually good.

results.name: Changed the name five times
results.headline: The sixth one is the right one.
results.body: You have redone the wordmark more often than you have talked to customers about it, and you know how that sounds.
results.cost: Nobody outside your head noticed any of the five.

results.name: Made the logo before the business
results.headline: It looked so real.
results.body: Having something to point at made it feel like it existed, and that feeling got you through the first month.
results.cost: A logo is the cheapest way to feel like you started.

results.name: Started three at once
results.headline: One of them is going to work.
results.body: You would rather have three half chances than one full one, and you are genuinely faster than most people at all three.
results.cost: Three at forty percent is not the same as one at a hundred and twenty.
